Janaza prayer: the four takbirs

1First takbir

With wuḍūʾ, face the qiblah and intend the funeral prayer. Stay standing, follow your imam, and recite quietly. There is no bowing or prostration.

SayAllāhu akbar

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

Allah is the Greatest.

Then recite Al-Fātiḥah

Raise your hands for the first takbir, then fold them. Seek refuge in Allah, then recite:

Aʿūdhu billāhi min ash-shayṭānir-rajīm.

أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ

I seek Allah’s protection from Satan, the rejected.

TRANSLITERATION

Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm.
Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbil-ʿālamīn.
Ar-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm.
Māliki yawmid-dīn.
Iyyāka naʿbudu wa iyyāka nastaʿīn.
Ihdinaṣ-ṣirāṭal-mustaqīm.
Ṣirāṭal-ladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim, ghayril-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim wa laḍ-ḍāllīn.

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۝ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ۝ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۝ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ

ENGLISH

In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all worlds; the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful; Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path—the path of those You have blessed, not of those who have incurred anger, nor of those who have gone astray.

Then say آمِين · Āmīn · “O Allah, answer.”

Then recite Thanāʾ

Raise your hands for the first takbir, then fold them. Recite this opening praise:

TRANSLITERATION

Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdika, wa tabārakasmuka, wa taʿālā jadduka, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.

سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ غَيْرُكَ

ENGLISH

Glory and praise are Yours, O Allah. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no deity besides You.

Some Hanafi guides add وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ — wa jalla thanāʾuka (“and exalted is Your praise”) before “wa lā ilāha ghayruk.”

2Second takbir

SayAllāhu akbar

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

Allah is the Greatest.

Then send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ

TRANSLITERATION

Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

ENGLISH

O Allah, bestow Your favour upon Muhammad and his family, as You bestowed it upon Ibrahim and his family. You are worthy of all praise, full of glory.

TRANSLITERATION

Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.

اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

ENGLISH

O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family, as You blessed Ibrahim and his family. You are worthy of all praise, full of glory.

3Third takbir

SayAllāhu akbar

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

Allah is the Greatest.

Then pray for the deceased

A short supplication for an adult, from a longer prophetic duʿāʾ.

For

TRANSLITERATION

Allāhumma ighfir lahu warḥamhu,
wa ʿāfihi waʿfu ʿanhu.

اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ

ENGLISH

O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him well-being, and pardon him.

4Fourth takbir

SayAllāhu akbar

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

Allah is the Greatest.

Then pause and end with salām

Pause briefly. Follow your imam, turn your head to the right, and say:

TRANSLITERATION

As-salāmu ʿalaykum wa raḥmatullāh.

السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ

ENGLISH

Peace and Allah’s mercy be upon you.

If your imam gives a second salām to the left, repeat it with him. Some schools include a brief duʿāʾ before salām.

School differences & sources

A common Sunni method for an adult’s funeral prayer. The Hanafi opening is available in step 1. Hand-raising, the final duʿāʾ, and one or two salāms differ by school; follow your imam. For a child’s funeral, follow your imam’s guidance on the supplication. English gives the meaning; transliteration is a pronunciation aid.
